body:
<!-- GENERATED:setup:overview start -->
escher is a fork of Blitz, a Rust library workspace for an HTML/CSS engine (high-level APIs for rendering HTML, a core DOM abstraction whose primary entry point is `BaseDocument`, a `Document` trait so wrappers around `BaseDocument` can all be driven by blitz-shell), being turned into an agent-first UI framework: a headless driver (CLI and MCP), stable ids for every element, a compact semantic snapshot of the screen, proven on an internal 7GUIs stand. Development is agent-driven: the framework's own driver is meant to become the harness.

**Stack:** Rust 2024 Cargo workspace 0.3.0-beta.4 (rust-version 1.91.0, no `rust-toolchain.toml`) · Stylo 0.22 · Taffy 0.15 · Parley 0.12 · anyrender 0.14 / Vello 0.11 · winit 0.31.0-beta.3 · AccessKit 0.25 · Dioxus 0.7.3 · Boa 0.22 · tokio 1.42 · reqwest 0.13 — a native-API engine library with no server and no database (the browser app keeps a rusqlite 0.32 history); versions as `Cargo.toml` pins them.
- `packages/` — the engine and integration crates and escher's own crates (telemetry bootstrap, driver)
- `tests/blitz-tests/` — integration tests, one file and one test target per behaviour; `checks/` holds the two committed kept checks
- `examples/` — example crates; `examples/seven_guis/` is the 7GUIs stand
- `apps/` — the reference browser and the markdown viewer
- `wpt/runner/` — the Web Platform Tests conformance runner
- **`blitz-dom`** — the headless DOM (`BaseDocument`): tree, Stylo styling, layout, events, scrolling, hit testing, the accessibility tree, the form controls' models and the document's clock
- **`blitz`** — high-level APIs for rendering HTML, re-exporting the engine crates
- **`blitz-vibey-script`** — `<script>` execution on the Boa engine with DOM bindings (`ScriptDocument`)
- **`accesskit_xplat`** — cross-platform AccessKit adapter
- **`debug_timer`** — utilities for simple, opt-in timings
- **`dioxus-native-dom`** — headless Dioxus renderer on blitz (`DioxusDocument`): stable element ids, the snapshot, its text, parts and diff, the UI graph and the reached record
- **`blitz-test-harness`** — headless `Harness` for blitz documents: virtual time, pump, settle, input synthesis, inspection, screenshot, contrast
- **`escher-telemetry`** — telemetry bootstrap for escher binaries: stderr `tracing` subscriber, service identity, target allowlist and scrub, panic hook
- **`escher-driver`** — the driver: session, command schema, executor, command line, MCP server, recording, replay and handler coverage
- **`browser`** — the reference browser app (`blitz` binary)
- **`browser-persistence`** — the browser's rusqlite history store
- **`rdme`** — the markdown viewer app
- **`seven_guis`** — the 7GUIs stand; its `escher-session` binary is the driver's command line and MCP server over six served tasks
- **`counter`** — a Dioxus counter driving the renderer
- **`todomvc`** — the TodoMVC app in Dioxus (`todomvc_native`)
- **`transparent`** — a Dioxus Native app with a transparent window background
- **`wgpu_texture`** — a custom wgpu-rendered widget inside a Dioxus Native page
- **`wasm_hello`** — the minimal WASM proof: `BlitzApplication` on `wasm32-unknown-unknown`
- **`wpt`** — the Web Platform Tests conformance runner (`wpt/runner/`)

- **`blitz-tests`** — the integration tests, one target per behaviour
<!-- GENERATED:setup:modules end -->

- none — the plans' §Anti-Patterns (Universal) hold no row; the every-turn guards are `.claude/rules/security.md` and `.claude/rules/host-linux.md`, the rest path-scoped in `.claude/rules/`
<!-- GENERATED:setup:warnings end -->

- The workspace serves no network port; beside three test-only binds (blitz-net's two `TcpListener`s on `127.0.0.1:0` and, since 2026-10-14-quality-gates, escher-driver's unix-only client unit test, which binds a `UnixListener` that never answers in `eab-{pid}` under the system temporary directory and removes it — each served by no binary, reached by no caller, no crossing), its one served listener is the driver session's local Unix-domain socket (owner-only; it carries the lifecycle and driver calls with their answers — ids, names, values, snapshot text and diff and, since 2026-10-12, a shot's pixels (a PNG as base64, a password in it painted masked, an open select list's option labels and group `label`s in it as painted pixels) and a lint's findings (stable ids, closed defect words and numbers) and a UI graph's ids, component, state and handler event names, closed flag words and booleans and an actions answer's ids, owner ids, the table's verb words, closed cause words and `keyed` booleans — each widening ratified; a new field of a closed value set inside an already ratified carrier is not a widening — his rule of 2026-10-10 — and the program's own fixed `'static` table text — the `help` self-description, a session error's remedy, each tool's description with its result fields — rides the command line's stdout and the `mcp` role's stdio as ratified carriers (his ruling of 2026-10-12), while text from a page, a call or a screen, an open value set, a new carrier or a new exit still is); the `escher-session mcp` role carries the same content to an MCP client over its own stdio — no listener, ratified by the founder (2026-10-10) — and, under `--record <dir>`, a kept check holds a recorded session's calls at rest — target ids, `press` keys, `advance` ms, text typed into unmasked controls, a masked or unresolved `type` as the stand-in — and its answers, each a digest and kept whole — masked as on every carrier, a shot's without its pixels, so the screens' ids, names, values, snapshot text and diffs, a lint's findings, a `graph` answer's UI graph and an `actions` answer's ids, owner ids, verb words, closed cause words and booleans, at rest — in an owner-only file never logged (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-19) — the cold-agent pipe's live child keeping its checks so in the owner-only `target/cold-agent/record/`, read by the pipe for bools and counts only, never printed, copied or committed —, the two committed Counter checks under `tests/blitz-tests/checks/` (`100644`, public) the one exception to owner-only — and the `escher-session coverage <app> <check>...` role reads kept-check files its caller names on argv as untrusted input, bounded and strictly through `Check::from_bytes`, an unreadable, over-bound, non-check or other-app file refused `malformed` holding nothing of the path, its stdout answer a coverage line of ids, owner ids, event names and two counts (a ratified boundary widening) — a new listener, port, env var or workspace crate is an arch §Occupied Resources registration, never a silent add.

- The a11y target is WCAG SC 2.1.1 · 1.4.3 · 2.4.3 and `accessibility` is a default feature — focusability, focus order and painted colours are a11y surface — `stand_keyboard` asserts each lean task's Tab sequence at boot (`common::tab_order`) and in its enabled states (`common::ENABLED_TAB_ORDER`) and Enter and Space on each stand button, so a focus-order change moves those tables, and `stand_contrast` asserts every stand control's text/background pair row for row, and the CRUD list rows, the text outside the controls and the colour states it reaches, hover, active and a select's open list included (`TEXT_ROWS`, `STATE_ROWS`), so a stand colour change moves its record; an open select list is asserted headlessly — SC 2.1.1 and 2.4.3 by `select_popup`, `stand_act_popup` and `stand_keyboard`'s list walks (only `stand_keyboard` in the `a11y` leg), SC 1.4.3 by `select_popup_painted` against `SelectListView`'s engine constants, in no sheet — and what an assistive technology reads of it is not measured, the windowed list read and not run; the load page and Cells hold Tab-order (`LOAD_TAB_ORDER`, `CELLS_TAB_ORDER`), keyboard and contrast rows, so SC 2.1.1 and 1.4.3 are asserted on the load page's `load-fetch` Button and on Cells' `cells-grid`; a truthy `inert` makes its subtree inert — skipped by Tab, passed through by a hit, out of the accessibility tree (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18), `stand_keyboard` and `inert_subtree` its pins — and HTML's focus fixup is built: a node that holds focus when it comes under `inert`, a subtree moved under an inert box included, gives it up at the mutator's flush, with no DOM `blur` or `focusout`, reading `is_inert()` alone, so a focused control that no longer shows, by `hidden`, `style="display:none"` or CSS alone, keeps focus and takes keys, with no panic; SC 1.4.3 is met on every measured non-exempt stand row since the stand's accent moved one step darker (white on `#3a5ce5`, 5.47; the old `#4a6cf7` read 4.39).

- Engine telemetry is `tracing` behind each crate's `tracing` feature: call sites are `#[cfg(feature = "tracing")]` with a no-op fallback, never an unconditional `println!`; escher's own crates take `tracing` ungated (escher-telemetry's startup and panic events, escher-driver's `command` and `tool_call` spans); escher binaries install `escher_telemetry::init` (stderr only, never stdout).

- escher's sink admits two target families and drops the rest: engine targets print only safe fields, escher's own (`escher_*`) print with content-named fields redacted, and a record from any other target is dropped whole at every level — so a sink-installing binary's stderr carries no element id, no accessible name and no typed text at any `RUST_LOG` level (measured on the `escher-session` host and its `mcp` role while they run calls and, since 2026-10-14-quality-gates, on a client's own stderr, the host on flows beyond the three CRUD commands and the windowed `seven_guis_native` built with the workspace on the host's display — 28 runs by build and level, 0 needles in every run: 0 id needles, 0 name needles, 0 occurrences of a typed sentinel and 0 of a shot's first 64 base64 characters at `trace`, under both builds — what a command prints on stdout is its answer, never a log line), a closed span's fields pass the same rule, and a third-party WARN or ERROR no longer prints either — while the upstream apps' `fmt::init()` and the WPT runner's `env_logger` log URLs, attribute values and outer HTML unscrubbed — add no new user-content log fields.
- Incremental and non-incremental layout must stay identical (incremental_oracle); pipeline tests run `for incremental in [false, true]`.
- DOM mutations go through `DocumentMutator` (`doc.mutate()`), which flushes on Drop — extend the mutator rather than reaching through `DocumentMutator::doc`.
- `NodeId` is a versioned slot id: a dropped node's id stops resolving and indexing a stale id panics — use `get`/`contains_key` for ids that may be stale.

- Dependency pins are coupled (html5ever family ↔ stylo web_atoms, skrifa ↔ parley/vello, svgtypes ↔ usvg, winit exact beta; taffy a registry version, "0.15", since the 2026-10-13 upstream sync, no git dependency left) — never bump one side alone.

- Work is not done until `bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh fast` (fmt · clippy `--locked -D warnings` · workspace tests · CI scripts · `embolden` — the legs CI runs, but for `embolden`, which has no CI job of its own) and `bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh doc` (rustdoc `-D warnings` over every workspace crate — `cargo doc --workspace --no-deps --locked`) pass; `fast`'s last step, `embolden`, builds `blitz-paint/font-embolden`, which macOS exercises in CI, and is the local witness for a paint change under that feature: `cargo test -p blitz-tests --locked --no-fail-fast --features blitz-paint/font-embolden --test select_popup_painted`.
<!-- GENERATED:setup:warnings end -->

<!-- GENERATED:setup:pointer-table start -->
The masters live in the store, no file: fire `python -X utf8 ~/.claude/skills/andromeda-tools/scripts/rec.py {verb} --root .` with `tree doc:{name}` · `render doc:{name} --section "{heading}"` · `find --doc {name} --text T` · `get {id}`, the id the command prints · an old `get {path}[:{n}]`, which names the fact it stood on (an agent reads a whole master by `read doc:{name}`, in pages).
| Directory tree · resource registry | `doc:architecture` §Infrastructure Patterns / §Occupied Resources — on rows the directory tree is the tree's own, `git ls-files` |

| Design tokens (as built) | `doc:design-system` §Color Palette / §Typography — the seven_guis stand's colours, type, depth, spacing and radius in `doc:layout-templates` §Surface: desktop-native, its font in `doc:architecture` §Standard Contracts |
| Test harness · agent-run contract | `doc:test-plan` §3 (keyed: `rec.py contracts test-plan`, one address per key) · `scripts/agent-run.sh` (contract tests `.github/scripts/test_agent_run.py`) |
| Observability pipeline | `doc:obs-plan` §3 (keyed: `rec.py contracts obs-plan`) |
| WCAG criteria · a11y harness | `doc:a11y-plan` §1 / §3 (keyed: `rec.py contracts a11y-plan`) |

| Change tracking (the changed set · its drain · the shell's refresh) | `packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs` (`has_changes`, `take_changed_nodes`) · `doc:architecture` §Cross-cutting Patterns · `packages/blitz-shell/src/window.rs` (`View::poll`) · the refresh's headless check `tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_accessibility_ids.rs` |

| Driver command and refusal schema (verb table · argument kinds and bounds · validation · causes and remedies · node keys and exit statuses · the `help` self-description) | `packages/escher-driver/src/{schema,command,refusal,describe}.rs` (unit tests inline, bar schema's in `schema_tests.rs`; its six shape types in its private child `schema/spec.rs`, re-exported) · `doc:architecture` §Standard Contracts · `doc:security-plan` §Input Validation · the capability statement `docs/capabilities.md` (its verb and cause names and its five counts held to these tables by `.github/scripts/test_capability_statement.py`, its other claims kept by hand) |

| Driver session (held instance · settled step · session socket and its wire · idle expiry · host role · session recording and its kept check) | `packages/escher-driver/src/{session,host,client,wire,error,recording,replay}.rs` · the coverage reader `packages/escher-driver/src/coverage.rs` (`handler_coverage`; check `tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_handler_coverage.rs`) and the reached record `packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/reached.rs` (`recording`'s unit tests in `recording_tests.rs`, its off-unix one in `recording_off_unix_tests.rs`) · host `examples/seven_guis/src/session_host.rs` · the committed checks `tests/blitz-tests/checks/counter-{cli,mcp}.json`, written by `examples/seven_guis/tests/flows/record_checks.sh` · checks `tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_session_*.rs`, `stand_replay.rs`, `stand_settle.rs` and the load wait's `stand_load_wait.rs` (shared `tests/session_common/mod.rs`) and `examples/seven_guis/tests/{host_binary,host_log,host_timer,recording}.rs` (shared `tests/common/mod.rs`) · contract `doc:test-plan/contracts/session-lifecycle` |

| Driver command line (argv reader · four endings and exit statuses · JSON written forms · the `start` spawn) | `packages/escher-driver/src/{cli,json}.rs` (`cli`'s unit tests in `cli_tests.rs`) · the binary `examples/seven_guis/src/session_host.rs` · checks `examples/seven_guis/tests/cli_{commands,flow}.rs` and the two flows `examples/seven_guis/tests/flows/{counter,flight}.sh` · `doc:architecture` §Standard Contracts · `doc:security-plan` §Input Validation |

| Driver MCP server (`serve_mcp` · the `mcp` role · tool listing · tool results · protocol errors and bounds · the `tool_call` span) | `packages/escher-driver/src/mcp.rs` and its three private children `mcp/{framing,listing,result}.rs` (unit tests in `mcp_tests.rs`) · the role in `packages/escher-driver/src/cli.rs` · checks `tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_mcp_{tools,masked}.rs` and `examples/seven_guis/tests/mcp_{server,log}.rs` (shared `Speaker` in `tests/common/mod.rs`) · `doc:architecture` §Standard Contracts · `doc:security-plan` §Input Validation |

| Drift detectors · amendment playbook | the `detector` and `rule` rows: `rec.py find --root . --kind detector` · `--kind rule` |
<!-- GENERATED:setup:pointer-table end -->
